fields.label: Restaurant Order
fields.description: The Hub's own order UUID, not a Frappe Link — orders are created and live only on the Hub (CLAUDE.md rule 4) and are never individually mirrored into Frappe; only the final bill syncs up, as a Sales Invoice (ticket P3-07). Same pattern as Void Log's own restaurant_order field.

fields.label: Line Item Id
fields.description: The Hub's own order-line id — one KOT record per kitchen ticket item, not per order.

fields.label: Item Name
fields.description: Denormalized at fire time (the Hub's own OrderLineRecord.name convention) so a later item rename can't change an already-cooked ticket's own record.

fields.label: Served At
fields.description: Only pushed once a ticket item reaches Served — a real, complete kitchen-timing fact (ticket P3-10's reworked scope: PRD's own 'KOT timestamps sync to ERPNext for reporting' requirement, delivered as an append-only audit record rather than a live Restaurant Order/KOT mirror, which CLAUDE.md rule 4 forbids). A voided fired line never reaches Served, so it never gets a row here — that line's own audit trail is Void Log's job, not this one.

fields.label: Correction Of
fields.description: Ticket P3-29: this record never edits or deletes the original - it is a NEW entry that points back at it.
